title: Skill tree
idea: Skill tree: Prerequisite paths and selected skill costs reveal progression
audience: People who need to unlock skill within a game surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its unlock skill priority and explicit commitment contract: Unlock validates currency and prerequisite state
navigation: Skill tree keeps the current unlock skill context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Prerequisite paths and selected skill costs reveal progression
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to unlock skill; skills have meaningful dependency structure
composition.priority: Unlock validates currency and prerequisite state

imagery.role: Support the actual unlock skill context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Provide accessible ordered skill list beside spatial graph
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the skill tree structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no unlock skill content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Unlock validates currency and prerequisite state
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized unlock skill content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Unlock validates currency and prerequisite state
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active unlock skill context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
